pages.text: The Lattice Conductor weaves the Pulse lattice; it makes no Pulse of its own. Pulse moves only along conductors: everything within **8 blocks** of one (generators, machines, camp hands, relays, totems and Pulse Cairns) is on its network, and machines draw Pulse only from the network. One craft makes four.

pages.title: Weaving a network
text: Conductors within 8 of each other link and weave one network, as far as the line runs. Two groups out of reach of each other are two networks and share nothing.
A machine draws from the generators on its network first, then from its [Pulse Cairns](pulse_cairn). It never draws straight from a generator, not even one right beside it: no conductor, no Pulse.

Totems on a network with Pulse in it fill their **250 Pulse** buffers from it and then sit full, which costs nothing more. That buffer keeps the totem's voice: an empty totem is silent (see [Keeping](keeping)). Machines never spend a totem's buffer.

Totems are joined with **Ritual Chalk** for their voices: right-click one totem, then another **less than 16 blocks** away. A station counts the voice of a totem chalk-linked to one near it, as long as that partner stands less than 16 blocks from the station. Chalk carries voices, not Pulse.

pages.title: How much it carries
text: Each conductor carries a set amount a second, by [rank](machine_ranks): **Woven 64**, **Attuned 256**, **Bound 1,024** and **Manifested 4,096** Pulse a second. A conductor from before ranks is Woven.

Pulse leaves a generator through a conductor within 8 of it and reaches a machine through a conductor within 8 of the machine, and counts against both. Pulse that leaves and arrives through the same conductor counts once. The links between conductors carry freely, so a network carries as much as all its conductors together.

A big generator wants strong or many conductors around it: one making thousands a second, such as a top [Ley Heart](ley_heart), needs a Manifested conductor (4,096 a second), or four Bound ones, to deliver it all. The same goes for a hungry machine.
A redstone signal on a conductor lifts it out of the weave until the signal ends.

steps.caption: A generator. No machine can draw from it until the lattice reaches it.
A Lattice Conductor within 8 blocks of it weaves it into the lattice.
A station within 8 blocks of the conductor draws on the network. Without the conductor it would starve, however close the drum.
Totems in reach fill their buffers from the network and sit full: that keeps their voices.

pages.title: Reading it
text: Right-click a conductor for its network: how many conductors, generators and cairns it holds, this conductor's rate and the whole network's, and the Pulse stored on it.
The [Ley Binding](world_rites) rite ties two distant totems for a while: the conductors in reach of one end weave into the network of the other.
The [Ley Lens](ley_lens) Pulse sight shows the network you stand on, through which conductor, and how much it carried last second.
The lattice carries Pulse, not goods. To move items over distance, use [relays](wireless_cargo).

pages.title: When it goes quiet
text: A lever or any redstone signal lifts the conductor out of the weave.
"No generator or cairn" means nothing on the network makes or holds Pulse: bring one within 8 blocks of any of its conductors.
"Dry" means the network's generators and cairns are empty: make more Pulse, or spend less.
"Carrying all it can" means the conductor passed its whole rate last second: rank it, or add conductors beside the busy generator and machine.
Crouch and right-click it with this book for its rank, what it carried last second, and what is missing.
